例句

  1. Everyone should be free to decide when to get married and whether to have children.
    每個人都應該能自由決定什麼時候結婚、要不要生小孩。
  2. You are free to sit anywhere.
    你想坐哪裡都可以。
  3. Students are free to use the computers in the library.
    學生可以自由使用圖書館的電腦。
  4. Feel free to use my bike while I'm away.
    我不在的時候，你可以隨意用我的腳踏車，不用客氣。
  5. Children should be free to play outside after school.
    小孩放學後應該可以自由在外面玩。
  6. Feel free to ask me any questions.
    有任何問題都可以問我，不用客氣。
  7. I don't know what to say.
    我不知道要說什麼。
  8. Can you tell me how to get to the station?
    你可以告訴我怎麼去車站嗎？
  9. We haven't decided where to go this summer.
    我們還沒決定今年夏天要去哪裡。
  10. My mother taught me how to cook rice.
    我媽媽教我怎麼煮飯。
  11. I'm not sure which bus to take.
    我不確定要搭哪一班公車。
  12. Please tell us when to start.
    請告訴我們什麼時候開始。
  13. She asked me what to wear to the party.
    她問我參加派對要穿什麼。
  14. Tom couldn't decide which shirt to buy.
    Tom 沒辦法決定要買哪一件襯衫。
  15. I can't decide whether to go or not.
    我無法決定要不要去。
  16. She is thinking about whether to study in Japan or in Korea.
    她在考慮要去日本還是韓國讀書。
  17. We talked about whether to take the train or the bus.
    我們討論要搭火車還是公車。
  18. I'm wondering whether to buy a new phone.
    我在想要不要買新手機。
  19. He asked his father whether to join the soccer team.
    他問他爸爸他該不該加入足球隊。
  20. My sister got married last year.
    我姊姊去年結婚了。
  21. He married a girl from Osaka.
    他跟一個大阪來的女孩結婚了。
  22. When are you going to get married?
    你什麼時候要結婚？
  23. Ann got married to a Japanese man.
    Ann 嫁給了一個日本人。
  24. Will you marry me?
    你願意跟我結婚嗎？
  25. My parents got married in Taipei twenty years ago.
    我爸媽二十年前在台北結婚。
  26. Many young people today are not sure whether to get married or not.
    現在很多年輕人不確定要不要結婚。
  27. They haven't decided when to have their wedding.
    他們還沒決定什麼時候辦婚禮。
  28. Everyone should be free to choose what to study.
    每個人都應該可以自由選擇要讀什麼。
  29. You are free to decide where to sit.
    你可以自由決定要坐哪裡。
  30. My cousin got married to her high school friend last spring.
    我表姊去年春天跟她的高中朋友結婚了。
  31. My parents have been married for twenty years.
    我爸媽結婚二十年了。
  32. Are you married?
    你結婚了嗎？
  33. Ken is married to a nurse.
    Ken 跟一位護理師結婚了。
  34. They got engaged in spring and got married in autumn.
    他們春天訂婚，秋天結婚。
  35. My aunt and uncle got divorced last year.
    我阿姨和姨丈去年離婚了。
  36. My grandparents were married for sixty years.
    我爺爺奶奶做了六十年的夫妻。
  37. My English teacher is married to a man from Canada.
    我的英文老師嫁給了一個加拿大人。
  38. My brother got engaged last month.
    我哥哥上個月訂婚了。
  39. My best friend is engaged to a doctor.
    我最好的朋友跟一位醫生訂婚了。
  40. They have been engaged for a year.
    他們已經訂婚一年了。
  41. Why did they get divorced?
    他們為什麼離婚？
  42. Her parents are divorced.
    她爸媽離婚了。
  43. They have been divorced for five years.
    他們已經離婚五年了。
  44. Do you know where to buy tickets for the concert?
    你知道要去哪裡買演唱會的票嗎？
  45. I asked the teacher how to spell her name.
    我問老師她的名字怎麼拼。
